problem_solved: The lack of highly standardized, accessible biocontainment facilities to rapidly test and validate new drug compounds against dangerous mosquito-borne tropical viruses.
description: A comprehensive Viral Bioassay Facility offering commercial antiviral screening services for Dengue and Chikungunya. The facility relies on the gold-standard Plaque Reduction Neutralization Test (PRNT). Client compounds (synthetic or natural) are tested via an 8-point serial dilution to quantify their exact capacity to stop viral cell infection. The facility calculates precise IC50 values, enabling rapid benchmarking of new drug candidates.
applications:
• Early-stage pre-clinical drug discovery pipelines for pharmaceutical firms

• Validation of bioactive compounds extracted from natural products and Ayurveda

• Academic and corporate R&D testing for novel antiviral therapeutics

• Contract research for molecular biology and bio-defense organizations
